negative_controls.note: Exact expected failure reasons and late-A-as-B observation checked by the regression script; not candidate failures or hardware acceptance.

mailbox_firmware_contract.wait_path: WAIT bit 0 skips the early DONE store, calls the handler, preserves WAIT while updating status, then sets DONE bit 1 and stores CTRL3.
limitations: Selected function decoding, not full firmware CFG or execution.
DONE is mailbox handler completion, not proof that Wi-Fi DMA has quiesced.
No firmware mutation, install, router access or wireless tests.
Host fixtures with explicit device ordering; not hardware DMA, concurrency, elapsed timeout or Air causal proof.
Pending request rejection is not command cancellation or firmware recovery; permanently incomplete work remains busy.
NPU stop/reset caller error handling, IRQ lifetime and PPE SRAM error propagation remain separate open issues.
Kernel and other 73 modules match r36; vendor firmware and wpad/LuCI are unchanged.
No router access, install, reboot, configuration change or additional wireless tests.
Native incremental build with pinned inputs, not clean-room reproducibility.
